We need to indicate number of CH3 groups in the molecule. But we have no description of molecule. Possibly we need to get NMR spectra to infer methyl groups. Could also be that the system has a sample at hand (maybe default). We can request carbon NMR or proton NMR. Methyl groups show characteristic signals: in 1H NMR around 0.9 ppm (singlet, doublet etc). In 13C NMR around 10-30 ppm.

We need to count CH3 groups. Use proton NMR to see number of methyl signals. But we need to know integration? The tool returns spectra as string, maybe includes peaks and integration.

We should first get proton NMR.
